blind_backtest.caveat: Leave-one-out on audited refused-to-granted pairs with structured deltas. Matching a later change is historical change alignment, NOT proof of causation. n is small and most pairs lack refusal themes, so the theme path often has nothing to say.

bottom_line.how_often_linked_correctly: Of 615 audited candidates, 1398 were accepted (overall precision 0.8204); high tier 93.5%. Counterfactual arm: 169 refused->refused rows audited, 113 accepted.
bottom_line.how_often_main_bottleneck_correct: top-1 accuracy 0.9114 (79 human-verified rows; scoring file theme_tagging_scoring.json (theme retag verification 2026-09-10).); micro precision 0.8826, recall 0.8826.
bottom_line.top3_change_alignment: theme-based top-3 matched 0.3882 (n=85); with a most-common-changes fallback it would match 0.7647; leading with most-common changes and re-ranking by themes matches 0.8824 with direction-correct 0.6588 (theme-conditioned directions: 0.6706). Baseline: 0.9294.
bottom_line.unsupported_suggestion_rate: All displayed theme claims carry source links; wrong-but-sourced rate is now measured as 1 - micro precision = 0.1174.
bottom_line.strongest: linking precision (93.5% high tier) and evidence provenance (100% source-linked).
bottom_line.weakest: bottleneck top-1 accuracy (51%), heritage/other theme tagging, and height/setback coverage.
bottom_line.rating: promising (not yet commercially useful for the optimiser claim; the evidence/linking layer alone is stronger).
cannot_yet_conclude: Whether recommendations actually improve real success chances (first counterfactual arm now audited, but refused-arm deltas are units-only and n is small).
National representativeness (audits are GE10-biased; theme tags verified on a 79-row retag sample).
